batch_node.name: GitHub core dimensions v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Dimension nodes for every dimension key the github_core plugin declares, so each key has a declared node before the dimension map moves to keying by node id (tap#708, tap#711).

node.name: github.observation
node.description: Whether a node or edge records what CI was declared to do (declaration) or what it actually did (execution). Defined in domain/dimensions/github.observation.md.

node.name: github.surface
node.description: Which GitHub product surface an observation came from (actions, apps, rules, pulls, releases, packages, secrets, security, ...), and so which credential could see it. Defined in domain/dimensions/github.surface.md.

node.name: github.owner
node.description: The GitHub account (organization or user) a repository-scoped row belongs to, as its login at collection time. Stamped by the collector on everything it reads under one owner, never declared on a type.

node.name: github.repo
node.description: The repository a repository-scoped row belongs to, as its name at collection time. Stamped by the collector alongside github.owner on everything it reads under one repository, never declared on a type.
